description.zh: 专注资料摘要、变化检查和例行汇总。自动执行，人在环中。
description.en: Repeatable research, monitoring and reports with human judgment.

zh: 帮我配置每日资料摘要，先确认资料来源和摘要偏好
帮我配置定时变化检查，有重要变化时请我判断
帮我配置每周例行汇总，先确认范围和运行时间
en: Help configure a daily digest, confirming sources and preferences first
Help configure recurring change checks that ask me about important changes
Help configure a weekly summary, confirming scope and cadence first
